note: Single machine-readable clinical parameter registry shared by the FastAPI backend and the React frontend. Prototype bounds are illustrative, not clinical limits.

parameters.definition: Anterior-posterior height of the nasal dorsum at the bridge.
parameters.limitations: Illustrative scene millimetres. Not a calibrated physical measurement.

parameters.definition: Lateral width of the dorsal bridge sides.
parameters.limitations: Distinct from alar width; the deformation is local to the dorsal sides.

parameters.definition: Reduction of a convex dorsal hump along the nasal dorsum.
parameters.limitations: Registered and parsed, but there is no independent hump geometry driver. It must not silently run as a bridge-height change.

parameters.definition: Overall straight, convex, or concave shape of the nasal dorsum.
parameters.limitations: Categorical/subjective shape concept. No numeric recommendation is invented.

parameters.definition: Angle between the nasal dorsum and the forehead at the radix.
parameters.limitations: Registered angle. It must never be written into a millimetre model field.

parameters.definition: Distance from the radix to the nasal tip.
parameters.limitations: Registered absolute length. The prototype has no independent nasal-length driver.

parameters.definition: Lateral deviation of the dorsal line from the facial midline.
parameters.limitations: Laterality is not resolved by the current parser; a side must be clarified.

parameters.definition: Deviation of the nasal septum from the midline.
parameters.limitations: No septal geometry or laterality driver exists in this prototype.

parameters.definition: Left-right difference in dorsal contour.
parameters.limitations: Direction and side require explicit clarification.

parameters.definition: Anterior projection of the nasal tip.
parameters.limitations: Illustrative scene millimetres; shares the tip deformation zone with tip height.

parameters.definition: Superior-inferior position of the nasal tip.
parameters.limitations: Illustrative scene millimetres; not a clinical cephalometric measurement.

parameters.definition: Rotation of the tip about the subnasale pivot.
parameters.limitations: Requires an explicit upward/downward direction. Pivot is a prototype frame, not a patient landmark.

parameters.definition: Sharpness and contour definition of the nasal tip.
parameters.limitations: Registered but not geometry-wired. A subjective refinement request never receives an invented number.

parameters.definition: Subtle depression immediately above the nasal tip.
parameters.limitations: Registered but not geometry-wired; must not alias tip height.

parameters.definition: Angle between the columella and the upper lip.
parameters.limitations: Registered angle; no geometry driver and no calibration.

parameters.definition: Visible height of the columella below the nostril rim.
parameters.limitations: Registered but not geometry-wired; must not alias cheek projection.

parameters.definition: Angle between the columella and the nasal lobule.
parameters.limitations: Registered angle; no geometry driver.

parameters.definition: Lateral spread of the alar wings.
parameters.limitations: Illustrative scene millimetres; distinct from bridge width.

parameters.definition: Outward flaring of the alar wings, distinct from alar base width.
parameters.limitations: Registered but not geometry-wired; must not alias alar width.

parameters.definition: Width of the alar base at the nostril sill.
parameters.limitations: Registered but not geometry-wired; distinct from alar width and alar flare.

parameters.definition: Contour of the nostril opening such as oval, round, or slit-like.
parameters.limitations: Categorical concept; requires clarification and is not simulated.

parameters.definition: Left-right symmetry of the nostril openings.
parameters.limitations: Laterality must be clarified; no symmetry driver exists.

parameters.definition: Width of the nostril opening itself, distinct from alar width.
parameters.limitations: Registered but not geometry-wired; must not alias alar width.

parameters.definition: Left-right difference in alar contour or position.
parameters.limitations: Laterality must be clarified; no geometry driver.

parameters.definition: Vertical height of the upper lip from subnasale to the vermilion border.
parameters.limitations: Registered but not geometry-wired; not a cephalometric measurement.

parameters.definition: Vertical height of the lower lip.
parameters.limitations: Registered but not geometry-wired.

parameters.definition: Anterior-posterior position of the upper lip.
parameters.limitations: Illustrative scene millimetres.

parameters.definition: Anterior-posterior position of the lower lip.
parameters.limitations: Illustrative scene millimetres.

parameters.definition: Outward fullness of the upper lip, distinct from projection.
parameters.limitations: Illustrative scene millimetres; separate field from projection.

parameters.definition: Outward fullness of the lower lip, distinct from projection.
parameters.limitations: Illustrative scene millimetres; separate field from projection.

parameters.definition: Vertical height of the vermilion (red) lip segment.
parameters.limitations: Registered but not geometry-wired; upper/lower vermilion must be clarified.

parameters.definition: Sharpness of the Cupid's bow contour of the upper lip.
parameters.limitations: Registered but not geometry-wired; subjective.

parameters.definition: Vertical length of the philtrum between the nose and upper lip.
parameters.limitations: Registered but not geometry-wired; no landmark calibration.

parameters.definition: Vertical or lateral position of the oral commissure.
parameters.limitations: Registered but not geometry-wired; side must be clarified.

parameters.definition: Left-right difference in lip shape or position.
parameters.limitations: Upper/lower lip and side must be clarified.

parameters.definition: Anterior-posterior position of the chin at pogonion.
parameters.limitations: Illustrative scene millimetres; chin prominence is treated as a synonym, not a duplicate parameter.

parameters.definition: Vertical dimension of the chin.
parameters.limitations: Illustrative scene millimetres.

parameters.definition: Lateral width of the chin.
parameters.limitations: Illustrative scene millimetres; distinct from jaw width.

parameters.definition: Angle between the lower lip and the chin.
parameters.limitations: Registered angle; no geometry driver and no calibration.

parameters.definition: Left-right asymmetry of the chin.
parameters.limitations: Side must be clarified; no geometry driver.

parameters.definition: Proportion of lower-face height occupied by the chin.
parameters.limitations: Ratio requires calibrated landmarks that the prototype does not have.

parameters.definition: Lateral width of the mandible/lower jaw.
parameters.limitations: Illustrative scene millimetres; not a mandibular cephalometric measurement.

parameters.definition: Overall contour of the mandibular border.
parameters.limitations: Subjective contour concept; no automatic numeric recommendation.

parameters.definition: Angle of the mandibular ramus relative to the mandibular body.
parameters.limitations: Registered angle; no geometry driver and no calibration.

parameters.definition: Sharpness of the outer mandibular contour band.
parameters.limitations: Illustrative scene millimetres; distinct from jaw width.

parameters.definition: Composite width of the lower third of the face.
parameters.limitations: Composite measurement; would require calibrated landmarks.

parameters.definition: Left-right difference in mandibular contour.
parameters.limitations: Side must be clarified; no symmetry driver.

parameters.definition: Anterior projection of the malar cheek region.
parameters.limitations: Illustrative scene millimetres; cheek prominence is a synonym, not a duplicate parameter.

parameters.definition: Outward fullness of the malar region.
parameters.limitations: Illustrative scene millimetres; distinct from projection.

parameters.definition: Overall contour of the midface.
parameters.limitations: Subjective contour concept; no geometry driver.

parameters.definition: Lateral width of the malar region.
parameters.limitations: Registered but not geometry-wired.

parameters.definition: Left-right difference in malar contour or projection.
parameters.limitations: Side must be clarified; no symmetry driver.

parameters.definition: Overall width of the face at its widest level.
parameters.limitations: Requires calibrated image scale; unavailable in this prototype.

parameters.definition: Overall vertical height of the face.
parameters.limitations: Requires calibrated image scale; unavailable in this prototype.

parameters.definition: Relative heights of the upper, middle, and lower facial thirds.
parameters.limitations: Ratio requires calibrated landmarks; no landmark calibration is available.

parameters.definition: Relative widths of the five vertical facial fifths.
parameters.limitations: Ratio requires calibrated landmarks; no landmark calibration is available.

parameters.definition: Lateral deviation of facial midline landmarks.
parameters.limitations: Requires calibrated midline landmarks; not available.

parameters.definition: Overall left-right symmetry of facial landmarks.
parameters.limitations: Requires calibrated landmarks and a symmetry definition; not available.

parameters.definition: Relative proportions between facial regions.
parameters.limitations: Requires a defined landmark set and calibration; not available.
